missions.title: Medical Supplies Run
missions.description: Deliver vital medical supplies to a frontier moon colony

objectives.description: Pick up medical supplies from Luna Station

dialogue.arrival: The dock worker hands you the sealed crates. 'Don't open these. Some folks pay good money for what's inside, if you catch my drift.'

objectives.description: Deliver supplies to Haven Colony

dialogue.arrival: The colony doctor rushes to meet you. 'Thank the stars you made it! We've got sick kids here.'

choices.text: Inspect the cargo before delivery

outcomes.description: You find the crates contain both medicine and black market stims

choices.text: Sell half the supplies to smugglers

outcomes.description: You made a profit, but the colony will remember this betrayal

failureConsequences.description: The colony won't forget you failed them when they needed help most

objectives.description: Meet your contact at the Asteroid Belt

dialogue.arrival: A scarred woman in a patched flight suit approaches. 'You didn't see me, I didn't see you. Cargo's in Bay 7. Don't get scanned.'

objectives.description: Pass through Corporate checkpoint
Deliver the goods to Miranda Station

choices.text: Bribe the checkpoint officer (2000 credits)

outcomes.description: The officer waves you through without inspection

choices.text: Use forged shipping manifest

failure.description: They spot the forgery! Prepare for combat or surrender

choices.text: Gun it and run the blockade

outcomes.description: Corporate security opens fire!

missions.title: Dead or Alive
missions.description: Track down the pirate captain 'Red Jack' Morrison

objectives.description: Gather intel on Red Jack's whereabouts

dialogue.tortuga_station: The bartender slides you a drink. 'Red Jack? Haven't seen him in weeks. But his crew was asking about fuel cells for a long haul...'
dialogue.smugglers_den: An old smuggler chuckles. 'Jack owes me money. Last I heard, he was hiding in the Outer Rim, near the derelict fleet.'
dialogue.neutral_zone: A nervous trader whispers, 'Red Jack's been hitting Corporate convoys. They say he's got a base in the asteroid field.'

objectives.description: Track Red Jack to his hideout
Confront Red Jack

choices.text: Attack immediately - Dead bounty (10,000 credits)

outcomes.description: Red Jack and his crew fight to the death

choices.text: Try to bring him in alive - Higher bounty (15,000 credits)

outcomes.text: You've got guts coming here alone. Tell you what - I'll come quietly if you let my crew go. They're just trying to survive, like everyone else.

outcome.description: Red Jack surrenders peacefully. His crew escapes.

playerOptions.text: No deal. You all come with me.

outcome.description: Negotiations break down into a firefight

choices.text: Listen to his side of the story

outcomes.text: The Corporations destroyed my colony for their mining operation. Killed everyone. My wife, my daughter... I'm just returning the favor. Join me, and we can make them pay.

playerOptions.text: You're right. The Corps need to pay.

outcome.description: You join Red Jack's crusade against the Corporations

playerOptions.text: I understand, but this isn't the way.

outcome.description: Red Jack respects your position but won't surrender

rewards.description: Rewards depend on how you handle Red Jack

specialEvents.description: Red Jack's scouts spotted you! They're setting an ambush!

missions.title: Desperate Measures
missions.description: Your contact Marcus has a job - steal medical supplies from a Corporate transport. It's dangerous, but you need the credits to survive.

objectives.description: Meet Marcus at the Rusty Anchor bar

dialogue.arrival: Marcus slides a datapad across the grimy table. 'Corporate transport, docking bay 7. Medical supplies worth 10k easy. We split 60-40, my favor for the intel. You in?'

objectives.description: Infiltrate the Corporate transport
Steal the medical supplies
Escape before security arrives

choices.text: Demand a 50-50 split

success.description: Marcus backs down. 'Fine, 50-50. But this better not come back on me.'

failure.description: Marcus laughs. 'Nice try rookie. 60-40 or find another job.'

choices.text: Take the supplies for yourself

outcomes.description: You cut Marcus out of the deal. He won't forget this.

missions.title: The Knife in the Back
missions.description: Marcus has set up a big score, but something doesn't feel right...

objectives.description: Meet Marcus at the abandoned station

dialogue.arrival: The station is too quiet. Marcus stands in the docking bay, sweating. 'You made it. The cargo's through here, just... follow me.'

objectives.description: It's a trap! Corporate Security surrounds you!

dialogue.trigger: Marcus steps back as Corporate soldiers flood in. 'Sorry kid, they offered me a clean slate. Nothing personal.'

objectives.description: Fight your way out or find another solution

choices.text: Fight your way out guns blazing

outcomes.description: You blast through Corporate security, leaving bodies in your wake

choices.text: Pretend to surrender, then escape

success.description: You fake surrender, then use a flash grenade to escape in the chaos

failure.description: They see through your ruse. Time for Plan B: violence.

choices.text: Make sure Marcus doesn't leave alive

outcomes.description: You put a bullet in Marcus before escaping. Word spreads - you don't forgive betrayal.

missions.title: The Beaumonde Job
missions.description: The heist that will make your reputation. Rob the Beaumonde Casino's vault during the Governor's Gala.

objectives.description: Plan the heist with your crew
Execute your infiltration plan
Crack the vault
Escape with the loot

choices.text: Sneak in through maintenance shafts

outcomes.description: Your engineer guides you through the maintenance systems undetected

crewDialogue.engineer: I've disabled their sensors. We have 15 minutes before they cycle.

choices.text: Attend the Gala as guests

outcomes.description: You mingle with the elite while your crew gets into position

choices.text: Storm the casino with guns blazing

outcomes.description: You hit hard and fast. Alarms blare as you fight to the vault.

choices.text: Your hacker offers to split the take if you cut out the crew

outcomes.description: You accept the hacker's deal. Your crew won't forgive this.

missions.title: The Earth Files
missions.description: You've intercepted encrypted Corporate communications mentioning 'Project Scorched Earth'. The truth about humanity's homeworld is darker than anyone imagined.

objectives.description: Decrypt the Corporate files

dialogue.success: The files reveal everything: The Corps deliberately triggered Earth's environmental collapse to force humanity into space, where they control everything.

objectives.description: Break into the Corporate Archive Station
Download the evidence of Corporate crimes
Decide what to do with the evidence

choices.text: Broadcast the truth to every station

outcomes.description: The truth sparks riots across the frontier. The Corps will never forgive you.

choices.text: Use the files to blackmail the Corporations

outcomes.description: You have leverage over the Corps. They'll pay to keep you quiet.

choices.text: Destroy the files - some truths are too dangerous

outcomes.description: You destroy the evidence. The truth dies with you.

missions.title: The Side You Choose
missions.description: The frontier is at war. Corporations, Independents, and Outlaws clash for control. Your choice will determine the future.

objectives.description: Receive offers from all three factions

dialogue.corporations: Join us. We offer legitimacy, wealth, and power. Help us restore order.
dialogue.independents: Fight for freedom. The colonies need a leader who understands struggle.
dialogue.outlaws: Take what's ours. No masters, no chains. Rule through strength.

objectives.description: Choose your faction for the final war
Complete faction-specific war missions
Lead your faction in the decisive battle

choices.text: Side with the Corporations - Order through control

outcomes.description: You join the Corporate fleet. Your past crimes are expunged.

choices.text: Side with the Independents - Freedom for all

outcomes.description: You become the champion of the free colonies.

choices.text: Side with the Outlaws - Take everything

outcomes.description: You embrace chaos and lead the outlaw armada.

choices.text: Side with no one - Forge your own path

outcomes.description: You declare independence from all factions.

missions.title: The Last Stand
missions.description: Everything has led to this moment. The fate of the frontier will be decided here.

objectives.description: Rally your allies for the final battle
Share final moments with your crew

dialogue.engineer: Whatever happens, Captain, it's been an honor.
dialogue.pilot: Let's give them hell one last time.
dialogue.gunner: Save the speeches. We've got work to do.

objectives.description: Lead the assault
With victory in your grasp, decide the frontier's fate

choices.text: Seize control - Become the Pirate King

outcomes.description: You crush all opposition and rule through fear. The frontier is yours.
outcomes.epilogue: Years later, your name is still whispered in terror. Ships pay tribute to pass through 'your' space. You got everything you wanted - an empire built on fear.

choices.text: Liberate the colonies - Become a hero

outcomes.description: You break the chains of oppression and free the colonies.
outcomes.epilogue: The frontier prospers under freedom. Statues of you stand in colony squares. Children play 'Captain and Crew,' always fighting for justice. You became the hero you never thought you'd be.

choices.text: Seek redemption - Atone for your crimes

outcomes.description: You turn from your dark path and choose redemption.
outcomes.epilogue: You spend your remaining years helping rebuild what was destroyed. Former enemies become allies. Your crew finds peace. In the end, you proved that anyone can change.

choices.text: Disappear into the black - True independence

outcomes.description: You refuse to rule or be ruled. Your ship vanishes into deep space.
outcomes.epilogue: Some say you're still out there, flying free among the stars. No chains, no masters, no responsibilities. Just you, your ship, and the infinite black. The only true freedom.
